newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU economic review of 1996 due next week.
newsitem.headline: EU economic review of 1996 due next week.

text.p: The European Commission will release next week a comprehensive review of economic conditions within the European Union during 1996, EU officials said on Friday.

The annual economic report, totalling some 130 pages, is expected to analyse developments in each of the 15 member states and reinforce the Commission's expectation of an upturn in gross domestic product during 1997.
"Formally speaking, the report should be on what happenEd last year," said one EU official.
Any projections for 1997 are expected to follow from the Commission's last round of forecasts in November.
At that time, economic growth in the EU was seen accelerating to 2.3 percent this year, with a further rise of 2.8 percent expected in 1998.
The Commission's next round of economic forecasts, which will include estimates for budget deficits and debt, is due sometime in May.
